topics.title: The journey to a different Bombay

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the details of Bombay and the train journey that show Gangadharpant is in a different world.
Explain what the signs of British rule in Bombay reveal about this alternative India.

topics.title: History rewritten in the Asiatic Society library

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the point at which history changed, as found in Gangadharpant's own volumes.
Describe the consequences of the Maratha victory for India in the alternative history.

topics.title: The Bakhar and the lecture at Azad Maidan

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the Bakhar and the torn page serve as evidence of Gangadharpant's experience.
Interpret the conflict over the empty chair and its effect on Professor Gaitonde.
Apply the catastrophe theory to the Battle of Panipat as Rajendra does.
Explain how lack of determinism in quantum theory leads to the idea of many worlds and transitions between them.

topics.title: Words and forms in the story

concepts.learning_objective: Infer the meaning of idiomatic expressions used in the story from context.
Recognise conditional sentences that express unreal and hypothetical conditions.
